race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
race.verdict: A thin race in which the improving SAXOPHONIC looks a clear stand-out. Storm On Jura is worth another chance to back up her Musselburgh win and can pose the biggest threat, with Someone's Wish appealing as best of the rest. SAXOPHONIC STORM ON JURA SOMEONE'S WISH (IRE)
